issues.failure_explanation: The previous paragraph only bounds stationary points inside (ell,u); it does not rule out a stationary point in [0,ell]. The IVT argument can only produce a root in [0,ell], and if it occurs at or below ell it gives no contradiction. Therefore the claim that ell is a maximum of e (i.e., p^*(ell) is the minimum) is not proved.
